RULE_GAS_SPIKE.description: Gas price significantly exceeds local window average or absolute threshold (>20 Gwei)

RULE_BURST_ACTIVITY.description: Rapid succession of transactions detected in 10-second sliding window (>=3 txs)

RULE_FAN_OUT.description: Rapid dispersion to multiple unique destination addresses within 60s (>=3 addresses)

RULE_REPEATED_TRANSFER.description: Repeated high-frequency value transfers between identical accounts (>=3 transfers)

RULE_CONTRACT_CALL.description: Transaction includes non-empty calldata invoking a smart contract

RULE_GAS_DEVIATION_LOW.description: Gas price below standard network baseline (<1.0 Gwei)
